title: Saw Stop - This guy puts a finger into an active table saw blade & comes away without a scratch!
summary: A short clip showing a person touching an active table saw blade with a finger and walking away unharmed, thanks to SawStop's system that stops the blade within milliseconds of skin contact.
why: Linked as the canonical demo of a safety technology that stops a blade before it injures a finger.

quote.text: The demo also never gets old. Just too badass.
